image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of a pipe organ console. The foreground is dominated by a vertical row of white, mushroom-shaped stop knobs (drawknobs) on the left side. In the background, slightly out of focus, are multiple stacked keyboards (manuals) with black and white keys. The lighting is warm, highlighting the glossy finish of the stop knobs and the wood of the console.
